findings.title: The right half of the first screen is empty

location.description: The hero: copy runs to about 700 px wide at left and nothing sits to the right of it.

findings.viewer_experience: The first screen looks lopsided, with all the content in the left half and an empty block beside it.

current.value: Text in the left 60 percent of the column, blank space to its right.

findings.target: The first screen reads as balanced, either with content on the right or with the text block placed to fit the page.
findings.fix_direction: Balance the hero across the width of the page.

closed_when.check: Look at the first screen: the content no longer sits in one half only.

findings.title: Card headings break mid-phrase

location.description: The three cards under "Why studios use Quillfern": "Send invoices / from a template" and its two neighbours.

findings.viewer_experience: Each heading breaks after a short first line, which leaves ragged, uneven two-line headings with a gap on the right.

current.value: Two-line headings broken early, with room left on the first line.

findings.target: Card headings wrap by the width of the card, not at a forced point.
findings.fix_direction: Let the headings wrap naturally within the card.
findings.source: Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style

closed_when.check: Look at the cards: the headings fill their lines before they wrap.
